name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes purpose (returns the per-job movement-cost table row). No address residue. 'for_job' matches the param being a job id.
purpose: Accessor that returns a pointer to the 20-byte movement-cost row for a given job (one cost byte per tile attribute class).
logic_summary: Computes &table + job_id*0x14, where the table base resolves to 0x61646 (= 0x615FD + 0x49). MUL by 0x14 stride, LEA the base, ADD, return pointer. Single basic block, EBP frame, __cdecl, one stack param.

params.name: job_id
params.semantics: Job / movement-class index used to select the cost row. Normal range 0..0x1A (27 jobs); callers may substitute movement-class overrides 0x13 (flying) or 0x10 (special unit), both valid job indices in the table.
params.reason: Name is accurate (caller derives it from bJob_id at +0x20) and carries no address residue.

returns.semantics: Pointer to the start of the 20-byte (0x14) movement-cost row for job_id at base 0x61646 + job_id*0x14. The pointer is passed by callers as the cost-table argument to fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill and fd2_pathfind_to_destination.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_movement_cost_table (table base @ 0x61646; Ghidra global currently named data_orphan_615fd_856b_leading_prefix_final_unreachable_unknown @ 0x615FD, accessed at +0x49)
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct and concise (purpose + assembly formula) but did not mention the 0..0x1A job range nor that callers substitute movement-class override values (0x13 flying / 0x10 special unit), which is why values outside a plain job loop appear in callers.
notes: Disassembly (MUL 0x14; LEA [0x61646]; ADD) confirms assembly formula in src comment. Caller fd2_player_action_menu_loop confirms param=movement class (from bJob_id +0x20, overridden to 0x13 flying / 0x10 special unit) and return pointer is forwarded to floodfill/pathfind. job range 0..0x1A (27 jobs) confirmed via fd2-knowledge jobs.md. The referenced table global has an address-residue name (data_orphan_615fd_856b_...) but that is a separate symbol, out of scope for this function-refine task.
